config.getitup.title: Get It up
config.getitup.restart: Which blocks carry giu_base is decided while every block is being built, so a change only takes effect after the game is restarted — a new world is not enough.
config.getitup.authority.local: These values come from config/getitup.json on this machine and will apply the next time the game starts.
config.getitup.authority.server: Connected: these are the values the server is running with. On a server only that machine's config/getitup.json matters — not this screen, and not an operator: an operator is not the owner of the server.
config.getitup.authority.pending: Connected, but the server has not sent its values yet, so what you see comes from this machine's file.
config.getitup.readonly.in_game: Read-only while a world is loaded. Editing here could not take effect before the next launch anyway, so the page is locked and shows the values that are actually in force.
config.getitup.mismatch: This machine's config/getitup.json does not match the server's. The server's values are the ones that count here; yours only matter when you host a world yourself. Mismatched settings make the client interpret block states with the wrong ids.
config.getitup.render.local: This page only changes what your own GPU draws: it never touches the world data and needs no server agreement, so it stays editable while a world is open.
config.getitup.render.reload: Press F3+T afterwards to reload resources. Models are baked during a resource reload, so no game restart is needed.
config.getitup.retexture.tooltip:
Upright blocks keep their textures attached to the world direction instead of rotating along with the geometry.
Turn it off to go back to patterns lying on their side.
Default: on.
config.getitup.texture_mode.tooltip:
auto: cut by world position; only dedicated half-height panel textures (*_slab_side) are replaced by the block's full texture before cutting.
project: always cut, which leaves a seam on panel textures.
refit: always stretch the used rectangle over the new face, which magnifies or squashes it.
Default: auto.
config.getitup.inject_slabs.tooltip:
Adds giu_base to every block that extends SlabBlock, including slabs added by other mods.
Default: on.
config.getitup.inject_stairs.tooltip:
Adds giu_base to every block that extends StairBlock, including stairs added by other mods.
Default: on.
config.getitup.dangerous_inject_every_bl:
Not a convenience switch. This adds giu_base to every block that is not a slab or a stair, multiplying their state tables by five and shifting the global block-state ids of everything registered after them.
Worlds saved under a different setting, and clients whose config/getitup.json differs, will read those ids as the wrong blocks.
Default: off.
config.getitup.dangerous_max_states_per_:
Blocks whose state table is already bigger than this are skipped by the dangerous switch, so fences, redstone wire and walls are not multiplied as well.
0 means no limit.
Default: 256.
key.getitup.mode.tooltip:
Hold this while placing a slab or a stair and it comes out standing up: a slab turns into a half-block-thick wall against the face you clicked, a stair falls onto its side into a corner missing one vertical column.
On floors and ceilings the click is read as eight sectors: the nearest edge decides which face the base hugs, the nearest corner decides where the corner block lands.
Release it and placement is exactly vanilla again.
